title: Online Banking Security Risk Calculator - Assess Your Safety
metaDescription: Calculate your online banking security risk level. Get personalized recommendations to protect your accounts from fraud and cyber threats.
description: Evaluate your online banking security practices and identify vulnerabilities. This calculator assesses your risk level based on authentication methods, device security, browsing habits, and more to help protect your financial accounts.

inputs.label: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
inputs.helpText: 2FA adds an extra layer of security beyond passwords

inputs.label: Banking Password Strength
inputs.helpText: Strong passwords are long, unique, and complex

inputs.helpText: Secure devices prevent unauthorized access to banking apps

inputs.label: Banking on Public WiFi
inputs.helpText: Public WiFi can expose your banking data to hackers

inputs.helpText: Rate your ability to identify fake banking emails (1=poor, 10=excellent)

inputs.label: Browser Security Practices
inputs.helpText: Secure browsers protect against tracking and malware

outputFields.label: Security Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall banking security risk level (lower is better)

outputFields.label: Security Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade representing your banking security posture

formula: let riskScore = 0; const twoFactorRisk = { 'none': 30, 'sms': 15, 'app': 5, 'hardware': 0 }; const passwordRisk = { 'weak': 25, 'medium': 15, 'strong': 5, 'manager': 0 }; const deviceRisk = { 'low': 20, 'medium': 10, 'high': 0 }; const wifiRisk = { 'never': 0, 'sometimes': 15, 'vpn': 2 }; const browserRisk = { 'poor': 15, 'basic': 8, 'good': 0 }; riskScore += twoFactorRisk[twoFactor] || 0; riskScore += passwordRisk[passwordStrength] || 0; riskScore += deviceRisk[deviceSecurity] || 0; riskScore += wifiRisk[publicWifiUsage] || 0; riskScore += browserRisk[browserSecurity] || 0; riskScore += Math.max(0, (10 - phishingAwareness) * 2); const finalRisk = Math.min(100, riskScore); let grade = 'F'; if (finalRisk <= 15) grade = 'A'; else if (finalRisk <= 30) grade = 'B'; else if (finalRisk <= 50) grade = 'C'; else if (finalRisk <= 70) grade = 'D'; return { riskScore: finalRisk, securityGrade: grade };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates key security factors including authentication methods, password strength, device security, network safety, phishing awareness, and browser protection. Risk scores are weighted based on common attack vectors targeting online banking customers.
tips: Enable two-factor authentication using an authenticator app or hardware key for maximum security
Use a unique, strong password generated by a password manager for your banking accounts
Never access banking accounts on public WiFi without VPN protection
Keep your devices updated and use screen locks to prevent unauthorized access
Use privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser to reduce tracking and malware risks
